description: This file defines the watch.Interface and related event types and fake/mock implementations for testing watch behavior in Kubernetes.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Implements the stop method for various watcher types, signaling the watcher to cease operation.

methods.name: ResultChan
methods.description: Returns the channel from which watch events can be received.

methods.name: IsStopped
methods.description: Checks if the watcher has been stopped.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Prepares the watcher to be reused by resetting internal state.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Sends an add event with the specified runtime.Object.

methods.name: Modify
methods.description: Sends a modify event with the specified runtime.Object.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Sends a delete event with the specified runtime.Object.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Sends an error event with the specified runtime.Object.

methods.name: Action
methods.description: Sends an event of a specified EventType with the specified runtime.Object.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Implements the stop method for ProxyWatcher, signaling it to stop.

methods.name: Stopping
methods.description: Returns true if Stop() has been called on ProxyWatcher.

methods.name: StopChan
methods.description: Returns the stop channel for ProxyWatcher.
